❯ /help                                                     

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Help  General   Commands   Custom commands

  Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with your
  permission, and executes commands — right from your
  terminal.
  Shortcuts
  ! for shell      double tap esc to      ctrl + shift + _
  mode             clear input            to undo
  / for commands   shift + tab to         ctrl + z to
  @ for file       auto-accept edits      suspend
  paths            ctrl + o for verbose   ctrl + v to
  /btw for side    output                 paste images
  question         ctrl + t to toggle     opt + p to
                   tasks                  switch model
                   shift + ⏎ for newline  ctrl + s to
                                          stash prompt
                                          ctrl + g to edit
                                          in $EDITOR
                                          /keybindings to
                                          customize

  For more help: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

  Esc to cancel
